benchmarks.note: Chapman–Enskog + Enskog (Gass 1971) hard-disk viscosity, comparison only; the channel value includes slip/Knudsen effects.

acceptance.description: No run halted by the safety monitor
Energy ledger (incl. wall work and heat) closes
Gas momentum change equals wall impulse
Steady shear: equal and opposite wall stresses
acceptance.criterion: |τ_bottom + τ_top| < 3 SE (per-run block averages, pooled) in every case

acceptance.description: Steady shear: wall work leaves as heat (no net heating)
acceptance.criterion: net energy flux gas→walls = 0 within 3 SE in every case

acceptance.description: The core velocity profile is a straight line (a single gradient exists)
acceptance.criterion: χ² p > 0.001 for the core fit in every run
95 % CI half-width (seed ensemble) < 10 % in every case
